property_summary: For any address and token id, balanceOf(account,id) in the correct contract returns the stored balance _balances[id][account] (including when account == address(0)); the mutant wrongly always returns 0 for account==address(0) and thus can differ for some inputs where the zero address actually has a non-zero stored balance.
change_summary: Invert the account zero check so that zero address always returns zero instead of stored value.
